name: Pyramids Apt. 7
headline: Jacuzzi 2BDR By The Historic Pyramids (Apt.7)
summary: Welcome to the Pyramids Boutique Apartments — the perfect place to enjoy a stunning view of the Magical Pyramids of Giza, Whether you're here for adventure or relaxation, our thoughtfully prepared space offers a comfortable and authentic local experience.

description.Space:
This bright and cozy apartment is designed for relaxation and comfort — perfect after a full day exploring the pyramids and the lively streets of Giza.

Inside, you’ll find:

✔️A private indoor jacuzzi, cleaned and sanitized before every stay
✔️Two king-sized beds with hotel-grade Egyptian cotton linens
✔️A bathroom stocked with fresh face and body towels
✔️A compact kitchenette for light meal prep
✔️A small dining table
✔️Wi-Fi, Cable TV, and Chrome Cast — all free of charge
✔️A Nespresso machine
✔️Complimentary bottled water, and two coffee capsules
description.Access:
✔️Guests will have full private access to the Apartment and all of its amenities during their stay.
✔️For larger groups or multiple bookings, feel free to contact us — we may have additional units available in the same building or nearby.
description.Interaction:
✔️We’re available to assist you between 9:00 AM and 4:00 AM Cairo time.
✔️Whether you have questions before arrival or need help during your stay, our team is happy to support you on via Airbnb messages throughout your experience.
description.Neighborhood:
⚠️Please note that occasional water or electricity outages may also occur due to local infrastructure maintenance. These are usually resolved quickly, we appreciate your understanding.

✔️ Safety & Accessibility
Despite the humble setting, the area is generally safe and the location provides unbeatable access to the Giza Pyramids.
✔️ Authentic Local Surroundings
The apartment is well-maintained and just as shown in the photos, but the neighborhood offers a modest, authentic experience. Streets may be dusty, unpaved, or littered, common in areas around the Pyramids. If you’re seeking polished or luxury surroundings outside the apartment, this may not be the right fit.
description.Transit:
✔️ Location: Just a short walk to the Giza Pyramids main gate — perfect for sightseeing.
✔️ Transportation: Uber, In-drive, and local taxis are easily available 24/7.
✔️ Private Services:
We offer convenient airport pickup, drop-off, and private guided tours across Cairo and Giza. Just message us to arrange in advance.

⚠️ Parking is not provided. Guests may use nearby street or private parking (subject to availability).
description.Notes:
⚠️ Electricity or water outages may occasionally occur due to infrastructure maintenance in the area. While this is beyond our control, we’ll do our best to assist you if it affects your stay.

Great location close to the pyramids. Door man Mohammad Hamada was amazing in aiding getting in and making sure I felt home

I highly enjoyed my stay here. Not only was the host, extremely responsive, but everyone in the building was more than happy to help.

The location was easy to get to once I knew exactly where it was. I’ve been cheered out on my own several times and had no problem walking right back to the hotel. 

Security is a big deal there. My room was located behind a barricade door, and not only did my unit have a double lock, my bedroom door had a completely different double lock. I felt very safe and secure there. 

Unfortunately, I had to cut my stay short because of an emergency, but when I do go back to Egypt, I will gladly stay with them again. 

At one point in time, I ran out of coffee, and the host sent someone immediately to bring me a new box of coffee, pods, much more than what I expected, and the service was astronomically great. 

If you’re going to be in Giza, I would recommend staying with this host. Some of the rooms have spectacular clear views of the great pyramids. 
10/10

The apartment looks exactly like the pictures, very spacious with two large, beautifully designed bedrooms, making it great value for money. Everything was well arranged and comfortable and while it may not look like much from the outside, the inside is much nicer than you’d expect. 
Check-in was slightly confusing at first. We had some trouble finding the correct apartment as the numbering wasn’t very clear: there were two apartments behind one door and the number we were given was only visible once inside, while a different number was shown on the outside door. That said, the host was responsive and communicated well when we reached out, which helped resolve things. Clearer check-in instructions would definitely improve the experience.
Overall, a great stay with an unbeatable view and excellent value.

The view of the three Pyramids is exactly as shown on the listing photo. It's absolutely the reason to stay here. It even better than the view from the panorama point inside the Giza Plateau. It took us 15 minutes leisurely walk to Giza Sphinx gate and we got in around 7.30am, and it was bliss to have the ground almost empty. 

Inside the flat is just as described. Master bedroom is spacious, living room a bit small. Hot water is very slow to fill the hot tub. The biggest down side is the smell of the kitchen drainage which is common problem here. I had a essential oil spray and that helped a little. 

Surrounding area is not attractive, but actually very convenient. There are pharmacies, grocery shops, roast nut shop, great BBQ restaurants that is full of locals. Also many restaurants and a good bakery in walking distance. Very quick and easy to call Uber. 

Quick response from the host team. So overall we are happy for 3 nights stay.
